name: Good Health
overview: Scripture teaches that good health is closely connected to obedience and reverence toward the LORD, promising protection from sickness when His commandments are followed (Exodus 15:26; 23:25). Wisdom in fearing God and turning from evil is foundational to well-being (Proverbs 3:7), while a joyful and positive spirit brings healing and strength to the body (Proverbs 16:24; 17:22). Ultimately, healing and salvation come from the LORD alone, who is the source of true restoration (Jeremiah 17:14).
